SELECT i.insp_id, i.doc_no, i.insp_date, it.item_name, w.product_lot, e.ename, i.result FROM inspection i, production p, work_order w, production_plan pr, item it, emp e WHERE i.prod_id = p.prod_id AND p.order_id = w.order_id AND w.prod_plan_id = pr.prod_plan_id AND pr.item_id = it.item_id AND i.emp_id = e.emp_id
AND i.insp_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND i.insp_date <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ( i.doc_no LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR it.item_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR w.product_lot LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR e.ename LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR i.result LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND i.doc_no LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND it.item_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND w.product_lot LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND e.ename LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND i.result LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY i.insp_id DESC

SELECT prod_id, item_name, product_lot, emp_id, ename, result FROM ( SELECT option_data.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY option_data.option_name) AS rn FROM (
SELECT MIN(p.prod_id) AS prod_id, it.item_name AS item_name, NULL AS product_lot, NULL AS emp_id, NULL AS ename, NULL AS result, it.item_name AS option_name FROM production p, work_order w, production_plan pr, item it WHERE p.order_id = w.order_id AND w.prod_plan_id = pr.prod_plan_id AND pr.item_id = it.item_id GROUP BY it.item_name
SELECT NULL AS prod_id, NULL AS item_name, NULL AS product_lot, e.emp_id AS emp_id, e.ename AS ename, NULL AS result, e.ename AS option_name FROM emp e WHERE e.dept = UNISTR('\D488\C9C8') AND e.ename IS NOT NULL
SELECT NULL AS prod_id, NULL AS item_name, NULL AS product_lot, NULL AS emp_id, NULL AS ename, i.result AS result, i.result AS option_name FROM inspection i WHERE i.result IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.result
SELECT NULL AS prod_id, NULL AS item_name, NULL AS product_lot, NULL AS emp_id, NULL AS ename, NULL AS result, NULL AS option_name FROM dual
) option_data WHERE option_data.option_name IS NOT NULL ) WHERE rn BETWEEN ((#{optionPage} - 1) * #{optionSize} + 1) AND (#{optionPage} * #{optionSize})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inspection ( insp_id, doc_no, doc_seq, emp_id, prod_id, insp_type, insp_date, insp_status, result, inspection_qty, good_qty, remark, created_date, updated_date ) SELECT (SELECT NVL(MAX(insp_id), 0) + 1 FROM inspection), 'INSP-' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{insp_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD( (SELECT NVL(MAX(doc_seq), 0) + 1 FROM inspection WHERE TRUNC(insp_date) = TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{insp_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), 4, '0' ), (SELECT NVL(MAX(doc_seq), 0) + 1 FROM inspection WHERE TRUNC(insp_date) = TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{insp_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), TO_NUMBER(#{emp_id}), TO_NUMBER(#{prod_id}), #{insp_type}, TO_DATE(#{insp_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), UNISTR('\C644\B8CC'), #{result}, TO_NUMBER(#{inspection_qty}), TO_NUMBER(#{good_qty}), #{remark}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE FROM dual
mapper.select: SELECT i.insp_id, i.doc_no, i.insp_date, it.item_name, w.product_lot, e.ename, i.result, i.prod_id, i.emp_id, i.insp_type, i.insp_status, i.inspection_qty, i.good_qty, i.remark FROM inspection i, production p, work_order w, production_plan pr, item it, emp e WHERE i.prod_id = p.prod_id AND p.order_id = w.order_id AND w.prod_plan_id = pr.prod_plan_id AND pr.item_id = it.item_id AND i.emp_id = e.emp_id AND i.insp_id = TO_NUMBER(#{insp_id})
